title: What Is an ETF? A Simple Guide for First-Time Investors in India
seoTitle: What Is an ETF? Beginner's Guide for Indian Investors
seoDescription: What an ETF is, how it trades on NSE and BSE, types available in India, the demat account you need, real costs and how ETF gains are taxed today.
